summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, reporting an amendment to its 2022 Incentive Equity Plan to increase authorized ordinary shares from ~671,641 to 781,641, and granting 100,000 RSUs to its CEO and 10,000 RSUs to a consultant. The RSUs vested immediately but the underlying shares cannot be registered for trading before January 22, 2027. The company relied on home country governance per Nasdaq Rule 5615(a)(3) to bypass stockholder approval. This is a routine equity incentive plan amendment and compensation grant, not a special situation.
